_meta.about: Researched look of every Gen-1 species (body plan, official colours, identifying features, gait) used by pipeline/blender/gen_pokemon.py (surface micro-texture, animation archetype, chain hints) and species_fixes.py (per-species anatomy patches). Compiled from Bulbapedia / Pokemon Fandom / PokemonDB species descriptions (see `sources`), not from any game asset.
